da5e6769b34d:
⚜️«The Entry of the Mother of God into the Temple» (21 November)

✧ “Today the Virgin Mary was brought to Jerusalem, into the Lord's temple, to pray, to speak with God and with the angels, to be deified, to become a living temple of the Holy Spirit, to prepare to give birth on earth to Jesus Christ, the Saviour of the world" – from a sermon by Father Cleopa (21 November 1999).

✧ As we wait to celebrate this great feast (the first of the Nativity Fast), we are showing you one of the icons on this theme, an icon I painted on glass (model: Savu Moga, 1860) for a holy Church in Dobrogea.
6631ba08be1b:
«The Archangels Michael and Gabriel» – one of the icons depicting the Holy Archangels, which we are showing you today, 8 November.
-
• Michael, whose name means “the power of God”, is the commander of the heavenly hosts and the first of the choir of the Holy Archangels.

• Gabriel, whose name means “man of God”, is the archangel of good tidings; his mission is to announce to people the great mysteries of God.

• Both are leaders of the choirs of angels and guides of souls towards Paradise.

• Happy name day to all who celebrate!
7b36ee774fe2: • Today, 2 November 2025, marks 241 years since the outbreak of the peasant uprising led by Horea, Cloșca and Crișan.
6885e1306c54:
Jesus Christ – the True Vine

• This unusual iconographic depiction is believed to be based on one of the Eucharistic prayers that the priest says during the Holy Liturgy, during the Cherubic Hymn: “For Thou art the Offerer and the Offered, O Christ our God…” (Teodor Danalache, crestinortodox.ro)

• This small icon was not ordered, nor is it for sale. I painted it one day because I missed this special theme.
b77a8b17f66a:
• 26 October: the feast of the holy Great Martyr «Demetrius the Myrrh-streaming» (Dumitru), one of the great holy martyrs, a wonderworking and healing saint.

• We welcome this great feast with an icon painted on glass in our workshop (model: Mărginimea Sibiului, second half of the 19th century).

• Happy name day to all who celebrate!🍂
104eceb0852c:
• «The Dormition of the Mother of God» – a study after a valuable icon from the collection of the Vasile Grigore Art Museum (Vasile Grigore was a painter and collector). It is an icon on glass (Țara Oltului, 19th century) listed as a national Treasure.

• The icon I am showing you today (made in our workshop) is not available; it was ordered for a holy Church in Brașov County.
7b149a47ee40: ✤“The Holy Archangels Michael and Gabriel, leaders of the choirs of angels and guides of souls towards Paradise” in a new icon on glass; this time, the order is for a holy Orthodox Church in Transylvania.
b5a5b60fb4b1:
✠ 14 September – «The Exaltation of the Holy Cross»

• «The Exaltation of the Holy Cross» is the oldest and most important of the Christian feasts dedicated to honouring the Cross of Jesus.

• Tomorrow's feast is a symbol of Christ's victory over death and sin, and stands for hope and salvation for all the faithful.

• The icon I am showing you today, [on the day of the great feast of «the Exaltation of the Holy Cross»], depicts «Saints Constantine and Helen», in the traditional model of the two emperors standing on either side of the Holy Cross.
c9e1d6f46c78:
▪︎ Every year on 30 August, Orthodox Christians celebrate Saint Alexander, Patriarch of Constantinople, known as ”the protector of mankind”.

▪︎“Happy name day!” to all named Alexandra and Alexandru!🌿
f8d0611be445:
Dear friends,

today, the day our workshop turns six, I remember the first icons I painted (2019), some of them being «The Table of Paradise» (model: workshop in Șcheii Brașovului, 19th century). Since then I have received over 25 orders for the icon «The Table of Paradise», the most recent being the photo of the icon we are joyfully admiring today.🎨

«The Table of Paradise» is also my first icon ordered for a holy Church.🙏

Thank you for all the icons I have painted over these years. Thank you for your patience and understanding in agreeing to wait your turn. Thank you for sharing, commenting on and liking my posts, and so supporting our page, which would not exist without you.🌺

We wish you and your families a new year of achievements, health, peace and joy, and for our workshop, many more beautiful icons painted on glass and many more orders.❤

Happy New Year 2026!

▫︎ «The Table of Paradise» – a personalised icon

▫︎ The icon «The Table of Paradise» is divided by diagonal bands into five fields showing: the Mother of God with the Child, Christ Pantocrator, Saint Paraskeva, Saint Nicholas and, often, a floral element at the centre of the composition, symbolising Paradise.

▫︎ For a personalised icon, on request we replace Saint Paraskeva and Saint Nicholas with the saints you prefer. In today's icon, the saints of «the Table of Paradise» are Saint Eugenia and Saint Claudius.

▫︎ Saint Claudius the Martyr – 19 March

▫︎ Happy name day to all who celebrate!
